basis: Immunodeficiency, congenital myopathy and ectodermal dysfunction define disease; enamel defects affect 80-99%. Iris hypoplasia omitted under four-axis cap.
Intestinal malrotation and midgut volvulus define the gastrointestinal disease; facial dysmorphism does not establish another damaged organ.
Inheritance-only umbrella with no shared organ or qualifying mechanism; empty labels reflect anatomical nonspecificity.
Acquired coagulation factor II deficiency; neither autoimmune causation nor underlying liver disease is universal.
Craniosynostosis, syndactyly, ptosis and strabismus define disease. Hearing loss is <30%; ear shape and canal narrowing do not establish common functional damage.
MSX1-related cleft lip, alveolus and palate affect oral structures.
Primary endometrial carcinoma arises in a reproductive organ, outside the 13 axes.
Benign tumour occupies cauda equina nerve roots.
Progressive joint stiffness, enamel hypoplasia and intellectual disability define syndrome. Narrow eyelid fissures and cup-shaped ears lack documented functional damage.
Brain anomalies, seizures and developmental impairment define disease; hearing loss in 2/2 assessed supports ear involvement. Retinopathy in one case has uncertain prevalence.
Inherited glycosylation disorder; developmental impairment and seizures affect most constituent syndromes (>30% across umbrella). Other organ defects vary by subtype.
Cherubism/osteolysis, gingival fibromatosis and intellectual disability/seizures define syndrome. Retinal pigmentation lacks demonstrated impairment; hearing loss is <30%.
Inherited magnesium transport disorder with renal tubular magnesium wasting; intestinal transport defects vary by subtype.
Structural aneurysmal abnormality of the cardiac atrial septum.
T-cell deficiency defines SCID. Pneumonia, candidiasis and otitis are separately diagnosed infections; supplied data do not establish other common direct organ damage.
Hereditary symmetric acral leukoderma is a cutaneous pigmentation disorder; no supported extracutaneous involvement.
Intellectual disability defines this umbrella; congenital anomalies in other organs vary across its many subtypes.
Immune-mediated arthritis and enthesitis define the group. Uveitis, psoriasis and inflammatory bowel disease are separately diagnosed and not universal.
Abnormally low intraocular pressure defines an eye disorder; inflammatory causation is not universal.
Acute erythroid/myeloid malignancy of bone marrow and blood-cell precursors.
Pulmonary arterial disease defines condition; pulmonary capillary proliferation in 2/2 assessed, ground-glass changes in 2/3 and respiratory insufficiency in 3/4 support lung damage.
Bacterial infection umbrella spanning intestinal, wound and systemic disease; no single anatomical target is established across the group.
Pulmonary arterial remodeling and right-heart dysfunction are cardiovascular. Dyspnea alone does not establish direct airway or lung-parenchymal damage.
Intellectual disability, developmental delay and cerebral atrophy define disease. Hypotonia is neurologic; skin and skeletal findings are <30%.
Tetralogy of Fallot is a defining congenital cardiac malformation; hypertelorism alone does not establish ocular or skeletal dysfunction.
